note: FROZEN question templates (ROE section 18 P3). One template per mechanism class. A question states why it arose, the observation, the hypothesis, the data needed, the pre-registered test shape, the baseline and the smallest effect of interest. Templates are text with fill-ins from the observation. They never contain, and the writer is never given, earlier results. A change to any template must bump qtVersion.
dataBoundary: Form and tune on the practice window (to 2025-09-04). Confirm once on 2025-09-05 to 2026-08-20. Anything after a hypothesis's freeze date is forward only. The frozen layers (HAR-800 ladder, R3 remaining travel, M2 confidence) and the shadow screens are neither inputs nor baselines.

notQuestions.stale: a data-health notice (an input is late); shown on the board header, not turned into a research question

itemLabels.vvix_vxn_drdt: rate of change of VVIX per VXN
itemLabels.vol_breadth: the number of vol indices above their own 90th percentile
itemLabels.cot_crowd_release: COT crowding going into a high-impact release
itemLabels.gamma_flip_dist: distance of spot from the dealer-gamma flip
itemLabels.gamma_breakout_breadth: the share of underlyings in short-gamma BREAKOUT

vol_term.mechanism: vol term structure and vol-of-vol state
vol_term.outcome: the realised range of NQ and SPX over the next {horizons} sessions, measured against what implied vol priced for the same days (IV divided by the square root of 252)
vol_term.baseline: unconditional days; and the same condition with VIX alone, so the question is the increment over VIX
vol_term.smallestEffect: a change in the range ratio that matters after costs, fixed before the run (set from the dispersion of the baseline, not from this observation)
vol_term.placebo: the same condition on dates shifted by plus or minus 1, 5 and 20 sessions
vol_term.dataNeeded: daily VIX family, VVIX, VXN, NQ and SPX daily range, from the committed daily files; no data after 2025-09-04 for Stage 1

ivrv.outcome: whether realised range converges to implied (the gap closes) or the gap persists, over {horizons} sessions
ivrv.baseline: the implied-vol forecast itself, and unconditional days
ivrv.smallestEffect: a change in realised/implied that matters for sizing, fixed before the run
ivrv.placebo: an unrelated asset's gap (FX) under the same rule
ivrv.dataNeeded: implied vol index and the matching asset's daily range

cot.outcome: the forward move of the instrument over the next {horizons} weeks, split by whether price is trending with the crowd or against it
cot.smallestEffect: a forward move that matters after costs, fixed before the run
cot.placebo: positioning shifted by plus or minus 4 and 13 weeks
cot.dataNeeded: weekly COT history for the instrument and weekly price; check the COT file is fresh

cot_release.outcome: whether price on release day moves against the crowd by more than on matched non-crowded release days, and whether it persists for {horizons} sessions
cot_release.baseline: matched release days without the crowding
cot_release.smallestEffect: a release-day move that matters after costs, fixed before the run
cot_release.placebo: non-release days with the same crowding
cot_release.dataNeeded: the economic calendar with impact tags and weekly COT; calendar tags after 2026-07-02 may be unknown

gamma.outcome: the next-session range over {horizons} sessions against a vol-matched random walk
gamma.baseline: a same-vol random walk; and days not in this state
gamma.smallestEffect: an extra range that matters for sizing, fixed before the run
gamma.placebo: the same state on shifted dates
gamma.dataNeeded: dealer-gamma history (the Cboe chain history is short, so there may be too few days to test this until more exist)

curve.outcome: what happens to NQ, USDJPY and gold, and to their range, over {horizons} sessions
curve.baseline: random dates (for a flip) or unconditional days (for an extreme or a class)
curve.smallestEffect: a move that matters after costs, fixed before the run
curve.mirror: the opposite move (re-steepening, the other class)
curve.dataNeeded: FRED yields (DGS2, DGS10, T10Y2Y, T10Y3M) and daily prices; events are few, so say so in the power statement

divergence.outcome: whether the gap between the pair closes over {horizons} sessions
divergence.baseline: a shifted-spread placebo of the same pair
divergence.smallestEffect: a closure that matters after costs, fixed before the run
divergence.placebo: the same pair with the spread shifted
